summary.text: Miguel Martinez is the Republican candidate for Colorado House of Representatives District 13 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democrat Consuelo Redhorse in a race with no incumbent.
His campaign website says he grew up in Colorado and previously served as county assessor.

paragraphs.text: Miguel Martinez's campaign website says he worked in his family's restaurant, hotel and liquor store before serving as county assessor.

It says he advanced to the ballot by petition and is running to restore the voice of the taxpayer, with plans to enforce the Taxpayer's Bill of Rights (TABOR) and make it easier to do business in Colorado.
He advanced from the June 30, 2026 Republican primary for House District 13.
